{{recipesummary | category = North American recipes | yield = 30–40 tiny meatballs | time = Prep: 20 minutes
Baking: 31 minutes | difficulty = 2 | image = [[Image:Vegetarian Meatballs.jpg|300px]] }} {{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:North American cuisines|North America]] This recipe for '''Vegetarian Meatballs''' is delicious and easy to prepare. The meatballs don't come out spherical; they are more of squished hemispheres, flat on one side. == Ingredients == * 1 large [[Cookbook:onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] * 1 package (340 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) Yves "Veggie Ground Round" ground beef substitute * 3 [[Cookbook:Tbsp|Tbsp]] hickory smoked [[Cookbook:Barbecue Sauce|barbecue sauce]] (recommended) OR [[Cookbook:Barbecue Sauce|barbecue sauce]] OR [[Cookbook:Tomato Sauce|tomato sauce]] OR [[Cookbook:Ketchup|ketchup]] * 2 [[Cookbook:eggs|eggs]] * 3 Tbsp [[Cookbook:breadcrumbs|breadcrumbs]] * ⅛ [[Cookbook:Tsp|tsp]] dried [[Cookbook:paprika|paprika]] * Low-sodium [[Cookbook:soy sauce|soy sauce]] to taste (optional) == Procedure == # Preheat oven to 350°F. # [[Cookbook:Sauté|Sauté]] onion; pour off oil and set aside. # In a large bowl, [[Cookbook:beat|beat]] eggs. Add the ground beef substitute, and break up well with fork. # Add all remaining ingredients and mix well. # Grease a large 12 x 18-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (31 x 45 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) baking tray. # Drop mixture onto the tray in tablespoonfuls. You should get 30–40 meatballs. Don't worry if the mixture falls apart a little on tray. # [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] at 350°F for 22 minutes. # Flip meatballs over. # Bake for an additional 9 minutes. == Notes, tips, and variations == * The barbecue sauce and/or soy sauce add an umami taste to the meatballs, which makes them taste more like real meat. * Any other pre-cooked ground meat substitute should also work.
